summary: Copies four consecutive 32-bit words from this (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC) to the destination pointer a2, then returns a2. A plain 16-byte struct copy with no arithmetic, branching, globals or callees. Structural twin of F_4x4MatrixMultiply_ef88 (0055ef88) per cluster prelabel. Heavily used by the network layer: called by sub_57CB50, UDPSocketBind (0057E860), NetworkGetLocalIP (0057E8D0), NetworkReceivePacket (0057E940), NetworkMessageQueueDequeue (0057EA30), NetworkPacketSend_ead0 (0057EAD0), NetworkThreadConnectionCleanup (0057EDD0), NetworkPacketSend_0c10 (00580C10) and sub_5813E0.

local_names.this: source struct holding the four dwords to copy
local_names.a2: destination struct receiving the copied dwords
local_names.result: returned value, equal to the destination pointer a2

operations.description: Copies dword at this+0x0 to a2+0x0
Copies dword at this+0x4 to a2+0x4
Copies dword at this+0x8 to a2+0x8
Copies dword at this+0xC to a2+0xC

Invoked by the network packet layer (UDPSocketBind, NetworkGetLocalIP, NetworkReceivePacket, NetworkMessageQueueDequeue, NetworkPacketSend variants, NetworkThreadConnectionCleanup, sub_57CB50, sub_5813E0)
